name: AdInsight Clarity
description: Provides integration for the AdInsight Clarity call tracking system.

suggests.drupal/token: Enables [adinsight_clarity:*] replacement tokens for the account, pool, base number and rendered span.

project_description: AdInsight Clarity (the vendor since renamed to ResponseTap) is a subscription call-tracking service that shows each website visitor a unique, dynamically generated telephone number so that phone calls can be attributed back to the visitor's on-site behaviour and marketing source. This module attaches the AdInsight/ResponseTap tracking script to every page (when an account ID is configured) and gives site builders four interchangeable ways to place the tracked phone number in the markup: a block, a text-format filter (the special <adinsight /> tag), tokens (when the Token module is enabled), and a directly pasted <span> element. A base phone number and a number-pool ID are configured in the admin form; the vendor JavaScript swaps the base number for a pooled number at page load, and non-JavaScript visitors still see the base number. It requires an active AdInsight/ResponseTap account to function.
